description: Head-movement mini-game GA21, opening Wave 2 Group E (precision control): angle-matching game. Voice calls a side and an angle (8 fixed trials: left 15, right 30, right 15, left 30, left 15, right 15, left 30, right 30 degrees); turn into the target band (plus/minus 5 degrees) and hold steady 0.8 s to hit. Wrong side past 27 degrees or 10 s without a hit is a miss; return to center gates every next call. A one-prompt start calibration (turn left once) learns which yaw sign means left. Temple tap starts and replays; no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: angle-match
